summaries.summary: Trump criticizes Macron amid rising unrest in France, claiming it will soon become a Muslim city. He connects the France situation to potential consequences in the U.S. if Democrats win.
Apple announces a product launch event for its new touch-screen MacBook Pro on October 28, alongside expected updates to its iPhone Duo delivery times and details about its foldable phone.
Walmart's Flipkart is reportedly expanding its food delivery service ahead of a public launch, which may pose a challenge to existing competitors in India.
The custody of two leaders from CJP has been extended for an additional two days by an Executive Magistrate.
Marco Rubio is visiting India to discuss trade, energy, and technology with Indian officials, while Hegseth makes an unannounced visit to Israel, stirring speculation about his discussions there.
Seven individuals have been detained in connection with a stampede during a religious gathering in Kolkata, which resulted in numerous fatalities.
After a shooting incident involving the actor Tiger Shroff, authorities have made progress in identifying suspects linked to the case.
Spotify is introducing QR code verification for family accounts to combat account sharing, which could result in penalties for users.
